For instance, during an operation against a Thanos-aligned gang, our agents provided training to local vigilantes in surveillance techniques and the use of encrypted communication devices. actual_output: Just another SHIELD agent with a bit of extra training, but I've had the privilege of facing some of the greatest threats the universe has thrown at us—like Loki's invasion and the Chitauri army.
